view: straight top-down (orthographic-looking) view of a square swimming pool; the motion plane is the water surface, facing the camera

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the deck/ground strip (y 820-1060) vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.04 px in all frames (scene/tracks/bg_shift.csv)
camera.perspective: none usable; pool rim appears as a near-square (458 x 456 px), so a single px scale applies on the water plane

objects.name: ring
objects.description: pink/red inflatable torus with blue-violet blotches, floating in the upper-left part of the pool; the only moving object
objects.reference_point: centroid of the filled outer outline = centre of the torus hole (object origin)

size_px.outer_diameter_range: fitEllipse major 73.6-74.2, minor 70.9-71.4; bbox 74-76 x 72-76 (bbox includes 1-2 px antialias)
size_px.note: seen from above: length = width = outer diameter; vertical thickness (height) is not visible in this top view

motion_summary_px.direction: straight line toward lower-right (image +x and +y equally, ~45 deg)
motion_summary_px.character: constant velocity drift for the whole clip (quadratic term ~1e-5 px/frame^2, i.e. no measurable acceleration); raw per-frame steps are dominated by ~0.1 px centroid noise, so use the linear fit for per-frame speed

objects.name: pool
objects.description: square pool of dark blue water with tiled floor, centre of the image
objects.note: water surface has small animated ripples; right ~1/3 of the floor is in shadow (darker), not a separate object

objects.name: pool_deck
objects.description: light lilac surface around the pool, irregular outer border against rough brown ground
objects.deck_tile_pitch_px: roughly 18-20 px, eyeballed, not measured (small square tiles visible in frames 0-23)
objects.note: its rendered appearance changes abruptly at frame 24 (tile grid disappears, becomes smooth/blurred lilac); a render/texture switch, not motion

objects.name: ground
objects.description: rough brown speckled ground surrounding the deck at the image edges

events.event: ring already moving (drifting toward lower-right) at clip start; no start of motion inside the clip
deck texture/appearance switches (tile grid disappears); camera and objects unaffected
clip ends; ring still drifting at the same velocity, no contact with the pool wall (ring right/bottom edge ~465/457 px vs wall 770/765)

no_events: no bounce, impact, contact, release or direction change
